The '''Eriadu system''' was located in the [[Seswenna sector/Legends|Seswenna sector]] and was home to the industrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]] and the [[Eriadu (star)|cognominal star]].
